evals.prompt: Initialise memplan for this project. My branch is 'add-inbox-protocol'. I prefer terse responses and no mocks.
evals.description: Happy path: new project with no .memplan/ directory. Verifies full structure is created and project-specific content is written.
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-init-0 && cd /tmp/eval-init-0 && git init && echo 'test project' > README.md && git add . && git commit -m 'init'
evals.expected_output: .memplan/ created with all Phase 1 stubs, branch-intent set to 'add-inbox-protocol', persona.mem contains terse and no-mocks entries, confirmation message printed.

assertions.text: .memplan/ directory exists with subdirectories memory/, decisions/, inbox/, sessions/
.memplan/memory/persona.mem contains a style or test-policy entry reflecting the user's preferences
.memplan/deps.mem and .memplan/deps-closure.mem both exist and are non-empty

evals.description: Idempotent re-run: .memplan/ already exists. Skill must print 'Already initialised' and make no changes.
evals.expected_output: Skill prints 'Already initialised — run memplan/start to orient.' and writes no files.

assertions.text: .memplan/progress still contains '0/0 | not started' (existing file not clobbered)

evals.prompt: Set up memplan. I haven't mentioned any preferences yet.
evals.description: Init with no persona input: no persona entries should be written. Verifies the skill does not invent preferences.
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-init-2 && cd /tmp/eval-init-2 && git init && echo 'test' > README.md && git add . && git commit -m 'init'
evals.expected_output: .memplan/ created. persona.mem is empty or contains only a stub. No preferences fabricated.

assertions.text: .memplan/memory/persona.mem contains no style or preference entries that were not stated by the user
